name: revertx
description: Restores what X removed: the Media tab's photo grid, the Likes tab on your profile, the photo grid in posts, and Copy link first.

scripts.zip: npm run build && npm run zip:chrome && npm run zip:firefox
scripts.zip:chrome: rm -f revertx.zip && (cd extension && zip -qr ../revertx.zip . -x '.*' '_metadata/*') && zip -qj revertx.zip LICENSE THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md && unzip -l revertx.zip
scripts.zip:firefox: rm -f revertx-firefox.zip && (cd extension-firefox && zip -qr ../revertx-firefox.zip . -x '.*') && zip -qj revertx-firefox.zip LICENSE THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md && unzip -l revertx-firefox.zip
